title: Integral coefficient-stage compact-support projection laws
statement: Let S be the specified six-functor operation datum [def-fix-six-functor-datum] for finite-field datum D, coefficient datum C, finite extension E of Q_l and positive finite level n. The canonical compact-support projection of [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates] satisfies CompactSupportProjectionLaws at S.higher.integral on S.integralFiniteTorDomain, and at every (S.closure.coefficientStages E0).integral on the predicate finiteTorConstructibleIntegral for its coefficient ring. The tensor and exchange maps are exactly the recorded integralTensor and integralExchange maps. The laws include invertibility, naturality, compactification independence, composition, the associativity pentagon and proper-counit identification. The first input is an arbitrary bounded constructible integral object; only the second input has the stated uniform finite-Tor restriction.

source.place: Finite formula, adic reconstruction, field transport and coherence paragraphs; coefficient-stage decomposition

proof.text: The finite-stage projection theorem gives isomorphisms at all positive reductions. Apply the normalized arrow comparison to the actual integral projection. Evaluation conservativity makes its derived coefficient-system reduction invertible. The reduction/total-limit adjunction has invertible units on complete objects, so naturality of the unit reflects this isomorphism back to the integral category. Translate canonical completeness to the legacy Roos completeness predicate using an auxiliary finite-field datum of characteristic different from l.

proof.text: Naturality follows directly by evaluating the naturality of the specified projection natural transformation in its two arguments. The existing compactification comparison theorem supplies compactification independence.

theorem compactSupportProjectionFormula_integralStages
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] {n : ℕ} {hn : 1 ≤ n}
    (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) :
    CompactSupportProjectionLaws S.higher.integral S.higher.integralTensor
      S.higher.integralExchange S.integralFiniteTorDomain ∧
    ∀ E₀ : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields C.l C.Qbar,
      CompactSupportProjectionLaws (S.closure.coefficientStages E₀).integral
        (S.closure.coefficientStages E₀).integralTensor
        (S.closure.coefficientStages E₀).integralExchange
        (fun X K ↦ finiteTorConstructibleIntegral C.l
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} C.l C.Qbar E₀) X.obj.left K.obj)
